stem: A client taking digoxin asks whether a high-bran meal can affect the medication. Which response is most accurate?

options.A: A high-bran meal can increase digoxin absorption severalfold.
options.B: A high-bran meal can reduce the amount of digoxin absorbed.
options.C: Bran has no effect on digoxin absorption under any circumstance.
options.D: Bran converts digoxin into an inactive drug before it reaches the intestine.

rationale: Digoxin prescribing information notes that when taken with meals high in bran fiber, the amount absorbed can be reduced. The item therefore tests a direct food-effect statement without extrapolating to an unsupported clinical outcome.
educational_objective: Recognize that high-bran meals can reduce digoxin absorption.
source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine
source_version_date: Current repackaged label updated 2026-01-01; underlying PI revised May 2024
source_locator: Section 12.3 Pharmacokinetics — Absorption: meals high in bran fiber can reduce digoxin absorption
source_claim_supported: High-bran meals can reduce the amount of digoxin absorbed.
